name: water-treatment
describes: drinking water answers: coagulant dose, disinfectant residual, contact time
caution: This pack is not a treatment authority and holds no treatment data. It carries no jar-test results, no residual limits, no CT tables and no plant constants. Every value comes from an authority the operator supplies and can name in a report. What the pack contributes is that a critical field with nothing behind it holds the answer instead of reading as a checked one.

dose.describes: a coagulant dose the plant's own table decides
dose.catches: a dose computed from raw water turbidity where the plant tables it against the jar test

dose_unit.describes: the unit the dose is stated in
dose_unit.catches: grams per litre reported where milligrams per litre were meant

residual.describes: whether the disinfectant residual sits inside the permitted band
residual.catches: an arithmetically correct residual that is below the floor the permit sets

contact_time.describes: contact time recomputed by the method the permit names
contact_time.catches: a basin volume used whole where the baffling factor reduces it

sample_point.describes: where in the plant the reading was taken
sample_point.catches: a compliant reading taken at a point the permit does not accept
